name: CRIMSON SPIRIT - Pineapple Ferment - Kalyancool Estate (In-House)
description:
Kalyancool Pineapple Fermentation – Crimson Spirit 

This is the best microlot we have roasted in last 365 days..

☕ Roast Profile Available:
Light Plus

100% Arabica 

Rooted in our own estate at Kalyancool, this experimental microlot celebrates precision fermentation and fruit-forward innovation. Crafted from 350 kg of fully ripened red cherries, this lot undergoes an anaerobic natural fermentation enhanced with 75 kg of fresh pineapple, carefully integrated with a developed yeast strain to guide flavor clarity and intensity.

Fermented for 72 hours with the fruit intact, this process unlocks a bold tropical expression while preserving balance and structure. The cup opens with an unmistakable pineapple candy sweetness, juicy and playful, followed by layers of jackfruit and ripe mango richness. As it cools, elegant hints of strawberry and plum emerge, finishing with a whiskey-like boozy warmth that lingers beautifully.

This is a confident, expressive coffee—crafted to stand out, not blend in.

📍 Estate: Kalyancool Estate, Chikmagalur
🌿 Process: Anaerobic Naturals with Pineapple
🍍 Fruit Ratio: 350 kg coffee cherries : 75 kg pineapple
🕒 Fermentation: 72 hours
🌱 Yeast: Developed estate yeast strain
🔥 Roast: Light Plus

Varietal: Chandragiri, Selection 795

Tasting Notes:
🍍 Pineapple Candy
🍈 Jackfruit
🥭 Mango
🍓 Strawberry
🍑 Plum
🥃 Whiskey-like Booziness

Experience Kalyancool Pineapple Fermentation—a vibrant, fruit-driven microlot where tropical sweetness meets controlled fermentation artistry.

Resting Period: Minimum 10 days

name: CT Estate – Caramelized Lychee (Yellow Honey Process)
description:
CT Estate – Caramelized Lychee (Yellow Honey Process)

☕ Roast Profile Available:
Light Plus

Nestled in the rich coffee-growing belt of Chikmagalur, CT Estate, under the careful stewardship of Mr. Sufyan, presents Caramelized Lychee—a refined and expressive microlot crafted with a strong focus on quality and precision. Known for his meticulous approach to cultivation and processing, Sufyan has been consistently producing clean, character-driven coffees that highlight both terroir and innovation.

This lot undergoes a carefully controlled Yellow Honey process, where a portion of the mucilage is retained during drying to enhance sweetness and clarity. The result is a beautifully clean yet layered cup, where delicate florals meet fruit-forward brightness.

In the cup, expect a graceful and aromatic profile led by floral tea-like notes, complemented by the soft juiciness of mulberry and the smooth sweetness of honeyed sugar. A gentle lychee brightness ties the profile together, creating a cup that is both elegant and refreshing.

📍 CT Estate – Chikmagalur, Karnataka
🌿 Varietals: Chandragiri & 5B | Elevation: 3600–3900 ft
🕒 Yellow Honey Process
🌞 Carefully Shade-Dried for Optimal Sweetness

Tasting Notes:

🍵 Floral Tea
🍇 Mulberry
🍯 Honey Sugar
🍈 Lychee

Experience the delicate sophistication of Caramelized Lychee, where floral clarity and fruit sweetness come together in a light, refined, and highly drinkable cup.

Resting Period = Minimum 10 days.

📞 Produced by Mr. Sufyan – CT Estate

name: Frozen Cherry Imperial - Jannapura Estate
description:
Jannapura Estate – Frozen Cherry Imperial

☕ Roast Profile Available:
Light Plus

Perched in the lush highlands of Chikmagalur, Jannapura Estate presents Frozen Cherry Imperial—a bold and experimental nanolot that redefines fruit-forward coffee through precision processing and controlled fermentation.

This lot begins with carefully handpicked, fully ripened coffee cherries that are frozen in an industrial freezer for 48 hours. This freezing step enhances cellular breakdown, allowing deeper infusion of flavours during the next stage. The cherries are then anaerobically fermented with yeast, developing a complex and layered profile, before being slowly dried on raised beds for 18 days to lock in clarity and sweetness.

description:
👑 Kalyancool Maharani

🌹 One of the most distinctive microlots produced at Kalyancool Estate this year.

Crafted through extended anaerobic fermentation, organic rose gulkand, and our proprietary Mélange Split Roast Technique, Maharani is an experimental microlot that explores a uniquely Indian expression of specialty coffee.

Maharani is not a traditional cultured coffee where microbial cultures are extracted directly from rose petals to create highly intense floral characteristics.

For this lot, we used standardized Lalcafé Oro yeast as the primary fermentation culture. Organic rose gulkand was introduced into the anaerobic fermentation environment to contribute additional floral complexity and aromatic compounds.

As a result, the rose character in the cup is elegant and integrated rather than overtly perfumed or dominant.

✨ Mélange Split Roast Technique

Instead of relying on a single roast curve, two separate light roast developments are created and blended.

☕ 50% of the coffee is dropped at the beginning of First Crack

🌹 Floral aromatics

🍓 Fruit clarity

☕ 50% of the coffee is dropped at the end of First Crack

The two roast profiles are then blended in an exact 50:50 ratio.

The result is a layered cup that combines aromatics, sweetness, balance, and depth beyond what a single roast profile can achieve.

Because of this roast architecture, the beans may appear slightly uneven in colour. This is intentional and reflects the combination of two roast expressions rather than inconsistent roasting.

🌿 The Story Behind Maharani

Produced entirely at our own Kalyancool Estate in Chikmagalur, Maharani began with carefully hand-selected fully ripened red cherries harvested at peak maturity.

Every batch was meticulously sorted, with all green cherries and floaters removed before processing.

The cherries then underwent our Bruised Natural Process, where the fruit was gently beaten and bruised before fermentation. This intentional bruising partially opens many of the cherries while leaving others intact.

The objective is to create multiple fermentation environments within the same lot. The opened cherries allow deeper interaction between fruit sugars, yeast, and fermentation compounds, while the intact cherries preserve structure, clarity, and balance.

This combination produces a more layered and expressive cup than a conventional natural process.

The coffee was then transferred into an anaerobic environment and fermented for an extended 120 hours.

During fermentation, organic rose gulkand sourced from:

🌹 Two Brothers Organic Farms

🌹 Kapiva

was introduced alongside activated Lalcafé Oro yeast 200g.

Approximately 5 kg of organic rose gulkand was incorporated into the fermentation environment together with activated Oro yeast to contribute floral complexity, sweetness, and aromatic depth.

Following fermentation, the coffee was slowly dried on raised beds to preserve sweetness, clarity, and elegance.

name: THERMAL SHOCK -  Ruby Pulse - Kalyancool Estate (In-House)
description:
Kalyancool Thermal Shock Fermentation – Ruby Pulse

This is one of the most technically experimental microlots we have produced this year—an expressive coffee that demonstrates how extreme temperature contrast and controlled fermentation can unlock deep fruit complexity and wine-like character.

☕ Roast Profile Available:
Light Plus

100% Arabica

Rooted in our own estate at Kalyancool, this microlot explores the effect of thermal shock processing combined with controlled yeast fermentation. Carefully selected fully ripened red cherries are first sorted to remove floaters and underripe fruits, ensuring only dense, high-quality cherries enter the process.

The cherries are then subjected to a thermal shock treatment, where they are immersed in 55°C warm water for 5 minutes. This controlled heat exposure helps soften the fruit structure and prepares the cherries for rapid cellular stress. Immediately after heating, the cherries are transferred to ice chamber and rapidly chilled, remaining in the cold bath for around 7–8 minutes.

This dramatic temperature contrast creates a “thermal shock” effect that enhances permeability of the fruit and intensifies the interaction between sugars, microbes, and yeast during fermentation.

After the thermal treatment, the cherries are gently bruised to create a bruised natural process, allowing partial opening of the fruit skin while maintaining the natural mucilage and pulp around the beans.

The cherries are then inoculated with activated Lalcafe Intenso yeast, a strain chosen for its ability to enhance fruity aromatics and wine-like complexity. Fermentation takes place in sealed Eco-tact bags for 72 hours, allowing controlled anaerobic conditions to develop layered fruit character.

Once fermentation is complete, the coffee is dried as naturals and carefully light (light plus) roasted to preserve clarity, acidity, and aromatic intensity.

The cup opens with fresh watermelon sweetness, juicy and refreshing. This is followed by vibrant pomegranate acidity, adding brightness and structure. As the coffee develops on the palate, deeper grape-wine notes emerge, bringing a rich fermented fruit character. As the cup cools, darker fruit layers of prunes and dried grapes appear, creating a long, wine-like finish with lingering sweetness.

This is a bold experimental coffee designed to showcase how thermal shock processing and precision fermentation can transform natural coffees into intensely fruit-driven microlots.

📍 Estate: Kalyancool Estate, Chikmagalur
🌿 Process: Thermal Shock Bruised Natural
🌡 Thermal Shock Step: 55°C warm water → immediate ice bath
🕒 Fermentation: 72 hours anaerobic fermentation
🌱 Yeast: Lalcafe Intenso
🔥 Roast: Light

Varietal: Chandragiri, Selection 795

Tasting Notes

🍉 Watermelon
🍷 Grape Wine
🍎 Pomegranate
🍇 Dried Grapes
🍑 Prunes

 

Experience Thermal Shock - Ruby Pulse —a striking experimental microlot where extreme temperature contrast, bruised natural processing, and controlled fermentation combine to produce a vibrant, wine-like cup.

description:

This is one of the most refined barrel-aged coffees we have roasted this year—an elegant microlot where specialty coffee meets the depth and character of whisky oak maturation.

100% Arabica

Sourced from Udaygiri Estate in Chikmagalur, this microlot explores how oak maturation can enhance coffee complexity while preserving clarity and fruit structure.

Carefully selected ripe cherries are processed as naturals and dried to the ideal moisture level. Once stabilized, the green beans are transferred into seasoned whisky barrels that previously held aged whisky. The beans are then rested inside the barrels for several weeks, allowing the porous green coffee to slowly absorb the aromatic compounds embedded in the oak.

During this maturation period, the beans take on subtle layers of oak wood tannins, vanilla sweetness, and whisky-like aromatic complexity, while still preserving the natural fruit character of the coffee.

Once the desired infusion is achieved, the beans are removed and roasted Light Plus, ensuring the barrel characteristics remain elegant and integrated rather than overpowering.

The cup opens with crisp green apple acidity, bright and refreshing. This is followed by juicy layers of kiwi, grapes, and stone fruits, adding a lively fruit sweetness that balances the barrel influence. As the coffee develops, the profile deepens into rich whisky-like warmth, supported by pronounced oakwood structure and delicate vanilla undertones that linger into the finish.

This is a sophisticated coffee that highlights how barrel aging can complement specialty coffee without overshadowing its natural fruit profile.

Please Note: This is a clean lactic-washed coffee and not a fruit-forward anaerobic natural. While controlled fermentation contributes complexity and sweetness, the cup remains elegant, structured, and clean. Customers seeking intense wine-like, boozy, or heavily fermented fruit characteristics may prefer our anaerobic natural offerings instead. This lot was intentionally processed to highlight the clarity, sweetness, balance, and nuanced character that premium washed coffees can offer when fermentation is used as a tool to enhance quality rather than dominate the cup. Crafted for coffee drinkers who value clarity, balance, and sweetness rather than intense fruit-forward or funky fermentation characteristics.

Washed Gold is a refined lactic-washed microlot produced at Navees Farm by Nirikshith A N, a modern coffee producer balancing a corporate career with a passion for farming and continuous innovation. With a strong focus on farm automation and quality-driven processing, this lot showcases how thoughtful fermentation can enhance sweetness and complexity while maintaining a clean cup.

The cherries are de-pulped and inoculated with Lalcafé Cima yeast, followed by approximately 72 hours of controlled lactic fermentation. The coffee is then hand-washed to halt fermentation at the desired stage, resulting in a cup that is expressive yet remarkably clean.

Grown at elevations above 4,000 feet ASL, the coffee expresses itself differently depending on the roast profile.

Light Plus opens with the sweet, refreshing character of musk melon. As the cup develops, gentle raisin-like fruit notes emerge, supported by the comforting sweetness of butter cookies. Roasted almond adds structure and depth, while a smooth cocoa finish lingers pleasantly, creating a balanced and elegant drinking experience.

Medium Roast emphasizes sweetness and body, offering comforting notes of butter cookie, roasted almond, dark chocolate, caramelized dates, and a lingering cocoa finish. The result is a smooth, sweet, and approachable cup that performs beautifully both as black coffee and with milk.
